custom_expected:
1. The role configuration matches: all 9 CRUD areas OFF, Reports ON with all other toggles OFF, Work Order sub-settings OFF, Full View, See Financial ON, See AP/AR ON, View History Logs OFF.
  2. Only the Reports area is reachable in the app; no CRUD areas are available.
  3. The user can open the Reports area and all 6 AP/AR aging reports, because the Reports permission is ON.
  4. Access to the AP/AR aging reports comes from the Reports permission (all-or-nothing), NOT from See AP/AR. See AP/AR only controls the customer/vendor AP/AR tabs and sensitive customer fields, not the aging reports.
  5. Nothing outside Reports is accessible.
custom_preconds:
1. Log in as a user assigned the system Sales Representative role.
  2. The role has the Reports permission turned ON.
  3. The role has See Financial Data ON and See AP/AR ON.
  4. All 9 CRUD areas are OFF, all other page toggles OFF, all Work Order sub-settings OFF, View mode = Full View, View History Logs OFF.
  5. Some AP/AR data exists so the aging reports have rows to show.
custom_steps:
1. Verify CRUD: all 9 CRUD areas OFF.
  2. Verify toggles: Reports ON, all others OFF.
  3. Verify Work Order sub-settings: all OFF.
  4. Verify View mode = Full View.
  5. Verify Cross-Cutting: See Financial ON, See AP/AR ON, View History Logs OFF.
  6. Click Reports in the top navigation and confirm only the Reports nav item is visible.
  7. Open the 6 AP/AR aging reports one at a time: AR Aging Summary, AR Aging Detail, AR Aging Collection, AP Aging Summary, AP Aging Detail, AP Unpaid Invoices.
title: Sales Representative: Reports + financial data only; no CRUD areas
